actions.name: read-file
actions.description: Download a file content from Zoho CRM. e.g.: a Backup File

actions.name: create_record
actions.description: Creates a record in any module, including custom fields.

actions.name: update_record
actions.description: Updates fields of a record in any module. Fields left empty are not changed.

actions.name: get_record
actions.description: Gets a record by id from any module, with all its fields.

actions.name: upsert_record
actions.description: Updates the record that matches on the duplicate-check fields, or creates it if none matches.

actions.name: delete_record
actions.description: Deletes a record (it moves to the Zoho CRM Recycle Bin).

actions.name: convert_lead
actions.description: Converts a lead into a contact and account, and optionally a deal.

actions.name: add_note
actions.description: Adds a note to a record.

actions.name: add_tags_to_record
actions.description: Adds existing or new tags to a record. New tag names are created first.

actions.name: upload_attachment
actions.description: Attaches a file to a record.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_contact
triggers.description: Triggers when a new contact is created

triggers.name: new_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is created in any module (custom fields included).

triggers.name: updated_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is modified in any module.
